title: Field Lens - weekly applied ML notes (quant + eval + onboarding)
content:
Meeting: Applied ML weekly sync — Field Lens
Dates: notes capture 2029-05-14, followup edits 2029-05-16
Owners: Asha (note lead), Liam (bench), Maya (eval harness)

Purpose: quick capture of experiments and operational blockers for current quantization + onboarding sprint. Informal — working assumptions and unresolved questions are called out.

Attendees:
- Asha Kapoor (lead)
- Liam O'Connor (bench engineer)
- Maya Chen (evals)
- Diego Ramirez (onboarding eng)
- Quick spot-check: Priya Singh (SRE) joined for rollout discussion

Summary highlights:
1) 4-bit KV cache stability probes — rolling window
   - Run: microbatch replay on the kv-prefetch branch with 4-bit LLM weights + asymmetric rounding applied to attention kv.
   - Throughput: stable at 88–92% of float baseline for 2k token sequences when batch size <= 6. Beyond that we see token-drop spike (p99 latency increases).
   - Observed artifact: occasional context-skew on long prefix-heavy requests (repro on seed 20290511-07). Hypothesis: quant rounding + cumulative scaler drift in KV cache.
   - Next step: add per-shard scaler re-sync after 64 steps and rerun replay. Liam to run overnight sweep (Jenkins job: bench/kv-4bit-resync).

2) Eval harness results (regression smoke)
   - Eval set: 2.6k prompts (mix: summarization, instruction-following, code-snippets). Baseline: fp16 v1.2.0; candidate: q4a asymmetric + kv-resync.
   - Quality delta: ROUGE-L median -1.4 pts, Code exact-match -0.8 pts; human spot-checks (10 samples) show coherent outputs but occasional tokenization glitches on inline code blocks.
   - Action: Maya to add tokenizer normalization step in post-processing and re-run selected failing cases (Ticket ML-3498).

3) Model onboarding checklist — new llama-compat variant (llamac-13b-lite)
   - Completed: model artifact checksum, config mapping, initial perf profile (latency/throughput), basic quant recipe created.
   - Blockers: provenance metadata incomplete for fused-ops layer (asked ops team for protobufs). Waiting on infra support to produce optimized kernels for fused-ops (PR #412 linked).
   - Risk: if kernels delayed, fallback to kernelless exec path will increase token cost ~15% for 2k seqs. Diego to prepare a fallback rollout plan and cost estimate for Product.

4) Rollout & observability notes
   - Canary plan: route 5% traffic to q4a variant in us-west-2, monitor token-error-rate, p95 latency, and drift in evaluation metrics (embedded in console route viz).
   - Instrumentation gap: we still need token-level alignment between bench traces and production logs for prefix-cached flows. Priya to schedule a short task to add trace_id propagation for kv resync traces (SRE-290).

5) Small experiments and jagged ideas (brain-dump)
   - Try per-layer mixed-precision: keep attention in q8, FFN in q4 for layers 8–12 to trade off quality. Quick A/B could be cheap if we use dynamic routing.
   - Micro-caching: store decoder-only partials for repeated short-chat sessions to reduce recompute; need to measure hit-rate in hosted traffic.
   - Auto-tune scheduler: use small RL signal to pick batch size vs latency SLO for specific routes. Probably future spike; add to backlog.

Open questions / unresolved:
- What's the expected long-term drift when using asymmetric rounding on kv across different model families? (Need cross-model probe).
- Cost baseline: confirm if Dedicated commitments can absorb fallback 15% cost increase — finance check requested.
- Should we standardize on per-shard resync or per-request bias-correction? Tradeoffs: resync cheap but stateful; bias-correction stateless but may add compute.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Liam: run kv-resync sweep overnight, collect per-layer activation histograms; ETA 2029-05-15 EOD. (linked: bench/kv-4bit-resync)
- Maya: add tokenizer normalization patch and re-run failing sample set; ETA 2029-05-17. (Ticket ML-3498)
- Diego: prepare fallback rollout + committed-cost estimate for Product and Finance; ETA 2029-05-18. (Linear ML-3421)
- Priya: add trace_id propagation for KV resync traces and open SRE PR; ETA 2029-05-20. (SRE-290)
- Asha: schedule cross-model probe planning session (30m) to scope drift tests; proposed slot 2029-05-21 10:30am PT.

Notes-to-self / misc:
- Keep the eval harness deterministic seeds synced across bench and prod to reduce noise — create small README in repo root describing seed policy.
- When we ship kernel fallback, add a short note in the console rollout UI calling out cost delta and expected perf impact.

Meeting artifacts & quick links:
- Bench PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kv-prefetch/pull/412
- Onboarding checklist: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ML-3421-model-onboarding-checklist
- Eval ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ML-3498-tokenizer-normalization

Next sync objectives (for next week):
- Confirm whether kv resync reduces p99 spikes for long prefixes.
- Validate tokenizer normalization effect on code samples.
- Finalize fallback rollout cost sheet and present to Product.

End of weekly capture. This is a working note — will move to in_review once the bench sweep completes and we have a cleaned eval artifact.

-- Asha
